role: root branch of a propositional tableau
notes: The list of the members of the finite set \(\Gamma\), each once, with no expansion marks.

role: tableau branch as formula list with marked positions
notes: \(M\) is a set of positions holding expandable formulas; an occurrence is a position, so equal formulas at two positions are two occurrences. \(C\) names a child branch.

role: set of formulas on a branch
notes: Chosen instead of \(|B|\) because the registry reserves \(|\cdot|\) for cardinality.

role: alternative of a tableau rule and the separator between alternatives
notes: Linear rules have one alternative and branching rules two; the bar is the sheet's own separator on sheet:tableaux-cpl.

role: list concatenation appending an alternative to a branch list
notes: Same glyph as the registered P6 stem concatenation \(s\mathbin{\frown}t\); same typed role (concatenation of finite sequences) in a disjoint scope.

role: expansion sequence of finite lists of branches
notes: A tableau rooted at \(\Gamma\) is the last member; \(T_0\) is the one-branch list of \(B_\Gamma\).

role: propositional formula size
notes: Number of occurrences of variables, falsum and connectives; parentheses are not counted. The P12 row uses the same macro for term-tree node count in its own scope.

role: termination measure of a tableau branch and its root value
notes: Sum of \(3^{\operatorname{sz}}\) over unmarked positions holding expandable formulas; zero on an open branch exactly when it is saturated. Other registered \(\mu\) rows are in disjoint P8, P9, P15 and P17 scopes.

role: branch valuation of a tableau branch
notes: True exactly at the propositional variables that are formulas on \(B\). The P15 and P19 rows using \(v_B\) are in disjoint scopes with different roles.

role: set of closed terms of the parameter-extended root signature
notes: Closed \(\mathcal L_{\Gamma}^{*}\)-terms; countably infinite; enumerated as \(t_0,t_1,\ldots\). \(\mathcal L_{\Gamma}\), \(\mathcal L_{\Gamma}^{*}\) and the parameters \(a_n\) are those of def:p02-fol-tableau.

role: fixed computable enumeration of the closed root terms
notes: Every member of \(\mathrm{CT}_{\Gamma}\) occurs; the index \(k\) schedules gamma and reflexivity tasks in the systematic procedure.

role: the equality-free first-order tableau calculus and its extension by equality rules
notes: \(\mathsf T\) is the calculus of sheet:tableaux-fol; \(\mathsf T^{=}\) adds reflexivity and replacement (def:p02-w02-p02-014-fol-equality).

role: the fixed variable marking the replaced occurrence in the replacement rule
notes: First variable of the fixed order on Var; occurs exactly once in the atomic formula \(\varphi\) and no other variable occurs.

role: set of done tasks of a first-order branch
notes: Generalizes the marked-position set \(M\) of the propositional branches.

role: tasks of a first-order branch
notes: Propositional or delta expansion at position \(i\); gamma instance at term \(t\); reflexivity at \(t\); replacement of an occurrence in position \(j\) using the equation at position \(i\). Angle brackets also denote finite lists in the same section; the task forms are distinguished by their entries.

role: limit branch of a path through an infinite expansion sequence
notes: Union of the lists and of the done sets along the path.

role: Hintikka set of first-order sentences
notes: Closure conditions (H0)--(H4); the formula set of an open saturated branch is one.

role: listed-equality relation on closed terms and its classes
notes: \(r\sim_H u\) iff \(r\) and \(u\) are the same term or \(r=u\in H\); identity when \(H\) is equality-free.

role: quotient Herbrand structure of a Hintikka set
notes: Domain \(\mathrm{CT}_{\Gamma}/{\sim_H}\); coincides with \(\mathcal M_{B^{+}_{\mathrm{at}}}\) of thm:p02-fol-tableau-adequacy when \(H\) is equality-free.

role: value of a closed term in a structure
notes: Abbreviates \(\sem{t}^{\mathcal M}_s\), which does not depend on \(s\) for closed \(t\).

role: stage tableau of the fair systematic procedure and its stage-\(n\) task list
notes: \(m_B\) is the list length of \(B\) at the start of the stage.

role: induction rank for the Herbrand truth lemma
notes: \(2c(\chi)\) for a negation and \(2c(\chi)+1\) otherwise, with \(c\) first-order complexity.

role: set of open branches of the stage-\(n\) tableau
notes: Used in the infinite branch construction.
